description: Turn any photo into a hand-drawn pencil sketch with a real color-dodge algorithm.

faqs.a: Grayscale, then invert, blur, and a pixel-level color-dodge blend — the same technique photo editors use.
Photos with strong outlines and good contrast — portraits and buildings work best.
A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Pencil Sketch Effect
